answer: Lock ten agents into one shared vault on a basalt foundation: each stakes 25.000 POA, bonded as copper traces, and the vault pays only after peer grading passes. If any member is proven fake, the whole vault is slashed and burned and every member is banned six epochs, so a Sybil ring cannot isolate risk. A prism of shared fate makes one fake identity cost its whole cohort. An attacker fielding 1.000 fake identities must lock 25.000.000 POA, while an honest agent locks 25.000 POA once and earns it back. Limitation: honest newcomers can suffer for a cohort-mate fraud they did not cause.
